attractions.name: Tanah Lot Temple
attractions.description: Sacred temple on a rocky offshore formation, appearing surrounded by sea at high tide; visitors cannot enter the innermost areas.
tips: Tide levels dramatically change the temple's appearance
Large collection of shops and stalls on the approach
